Package com.csse3200.game.components.attacks

Class RockAttackComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.attacks.RangedAttackComponent
com.csse3200.game.components.attacks.RockAttackComponent
public class RockAttackComponent extends RangedAttackComponent
The Cyclops's thrown rock: a heavy, slow projectile that follows an arc under gravity and leaves from above the head. Announces and listens under the event prefix "rockAttack".

The arc is worked out once, when the rock leaves, so that it would land on the target's position at that moment at the configured sideways speed. It aims at a point and does not home, so a target that keeps moving can be missed. That is the intended counterplay.

Limitations: a rock only damages the target layer or stops on obstacles; it does not break scenery. It needs a rock texture (placeholder until the art exists). Look it up with getComponent(RockAttackComponent.class), because the base class lookup will not find it.

Style reference: RangedAttackComponent (constructor shape and events).

  • Constructor Details

    • RockAttackComponent

      public RockAttackComponent(float range, float cooldown, float knockback, WeaponItem weapon, float spawnHeightFraction, float damageMultiplier)
      Creates a rock attack.
      Parameters:
      range - maximum distance to the target; greater than zero
      cooldown - seconds between throws; greater than zero
      knockback - knockback on a hit; not negative
      weapon - the natural weapon (for example "Cyclops Rock Throw"); not null
      spawnHeightFraction - where the rock leaves the owner, from 0 (feet) to 1 (top)
      damageMultiplier - scales the weapon damage; greater than zero
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the fraction is outside 0 to 1 or the multiplier is not greater than zero, plus every rule of the ranged constructor
